dispatch.name: P8 complete scale measurements
dispatch.scope: There are no configurable dispatch inputs; scales/repetitions/budgets/first-shard gate are fixed by the original workflow and driver.

json_body_template.ref: <dedicated branch or tag pointing to final combined G>

dispatch.inputs_field: omit; there are no inputs in this workflow

official_api_reference.relevant_rule: The ref body parameter is a branch or tag name. Do not invent a SHA-only ref.
official_api_reference.response_handling: Retain actual response/status from the selected supported API version/tool, then obtain and verify the new run identity. Do not assume a transport response is study success.

preconditions: Root has completed and frozen actual combined P/R/G and required source admission/independent reviews; this document does not confer that approval.
A dedicated remote branch or tag exists and resolves to the exact full combined G; read/record its remote full SHA immediately before dispatch and keep it fixed.
Verify workflow/driver/helper/capacity preparation bytes at actual combined G against their approved mapping. If changed, this precomputed comparison no longer applies.
Create a new workflow_dispatch run; do not use rerun-failed-jobs against the old a23 incident.

Read returned/new run metadata and assert event=workflow_dispatch, actual head_sha=combined G, expected workflow path, new run_id and initial run_attempt; preserve response and metadata. Workflow checkout uses event pull-request head or github.sha, so a dispatch checks out event fixed github.sha.

Keep every old failed/partial a23 run, build and artifact identity separately. The new study begins with its own new build and complete150 population; it is not replacement credit for old primary slots.

original_jobs.note: One newly built immutable binary and build receipt for every shard in this study; never substitute an old receipt.

original_jobs.registered_population: The original repetition0 at every scale; these5 are counted once among150, not excluded smoke.
145 remaining original slices, started only if all5 initial slices succeed.

original_jobs.original_python_call: matrix.aggregate(root / 'p8-scale-build', inputs, root / 'p8-scale-matrix', repetitions=30, shard_count=30, capacity_profile=matrix.CAPACITY_PROFILE)

output_and_identity_constraints: All build/run/aggregate output directories must be new/nonexistent: new_directory uses mkdir without exist_ok. Evidence files use xb create-new. Never clear/reuse an old output to make an attempted rerun appear new.

Fresh workflow run_id supplies new build/capacity/shard/matrix artifact names. Original workflow has no run_attempt component and no explicit overwrite input; record actual run_attempt and artifact ID/digest externally rather than assuming attempt-safe naming.
Every validate_shard requires sealed complete original file inventory, passed/exit0, the exact same new build.json SHA and source/binary/driver values. Source-before and source-after must match.

Collector rejects missing or duplicate scale/shard and requires every group to have exact repetition0..29 and all original full15-table checkpoints. A missing/failed first slice prevents full acceptance.
No runtime/scale sample from a23, G2, prior G or Mac/oracle/FTS local prototypes is imported into this future combined-source study.
Retain exact original stdout/stderr, source/binary/build/plan receipts, capacity observations, raw rows, artifact metadata/digests and failed/skipped final states.
